about: The rig's cameras, read by cameras/server.py and harness/cameras.py. Camera i in this list publishes on port + i.
usb: part of the camera's USB product name. size: the MJPEG mode, before rotation. rotate: 0, 90, 180 or -90.
slot: USB bytes per microframe to reserve, one of slots (the camera's alternate settings). A slot too small for
the MJPEG bursts gives damaged frames; too big and the cameras don't all fit on one USB controller.
controls: UVC controls by display name, applied in order on every (re)open and again whenever this file changes.

overhead.note: Logitech C270. Power line 1 = 50 Hz mains; it ships set to 60 Hz, which flickers here.

left_wrist.note: Only does 30 fps at 1024x768 or 1920x1080. Its auto exposure stays near black indoors, so it runs manual: 250 = 25 ms, the longest that keeps 30 fps (300+ wraps back to short).
